priorityList: Charge to engage and Pummel to interrupt enemy spellcasting.
Maintain Rend on all targets, using Thunder Clap to apply/refresh it if talented.
Use Sweeping Strikes if Colossus Smash has more than 10 seconds remaining on its cooldown.
Cast Ravager when Colossus Smash is nearly ready (less than 3 seconds remaining).
Use Avatar and Colossus Smash (or Warbreaker) together as your primary burst window.
Cast Champion's Spear while the Colossus Smash debuff is active on targets.
Use Demolish immediately if you reach 10 stacks of Colossal Might.
Use Demolish while Colossus Smash is active, provided it has at least 2 seconds remaining.
Use Cleave as your primary Rage spender for AoE damage.
Use Whirlwind if you have 3 stacks of Collateral Damage and Fervor of Battle is talented.
In Execute phase, prioritize Mortal Strike if you have 2 stacks of Executioner's Precision.
Use Overpower to generate Rage and build stacks of Martial Prowess.
Use Execute whenever Sudden Death procs or when targets are in the Execute health range.
Use Bladestorm as a powerful filler during the Colossus Smash window.
Sync on-use damage trinkets and racial buffs (like Blood Fury or Berserking) with Avatar and Colossus Smash.
